meta.name: gemini-browser-image
meta.description: Drive the logged-in Gemini web app in a real browser to generate or edit images without API keys. Use when browser persistence, existing login state, uploads, or real Gemini page behavior matter more than direct API access.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动浏览器用 Gemini 网页生成并编辑图像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想设置 API 密钥，直接使用 Gemini 网页生成图像
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser to generate or edit images using the Gemini web app, no API keys needed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer using the Gemini web app directly without API keys

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会驱动已登录的Gemini网页，在真实浏览器中根据你的描述生成或编辑图像，无需API密钥。完成生成后，它会将图像保存到本地。
howto.when: 当你需要生成图像或基于已有图像进行编辑，且更依赖浏览器登录状态和真实页面行为时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张夕阳下的海滩图片。
say.note: 这会让Gemini生成图像并保存到本地。

say.text: 用这张照片做参考，生成类似风格的图。
say.note: 需要你先上传参考图到Gemini。

say.text: 修改这张图片，让它看起来像油画风格。

howto.what_en: This skill drives the logged-in Gemini web app in a real browser to generate or edit images without API keys. It opens a Gemini tab, submits your prompt, waits for generation, and saves the resulting image locally.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to generate or edit images and browser login state or real page behavior is preferred over direct API access.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a sunset beach.
say_en.note: This will drive Gemini to generate and save the image.

say_en.text: Use this photo as reference to create a similar style image.
say_en.note: You need to upload the reference image to Gemini first.

say_en.text: Edit this image to look like an oil painting.
